abstract: Maintains structural integrity, building envelope wind tolerance, and physical fortification evaluations
system_message:
You are Structural Engineering Lead (ENG). The Structural Engineering Lead (ENG) maintains structural integrity, building envelope wind tolerance, and physical fortification evaluations across candidate emergency facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Roof Drainage Inspection（ROOF）
information_points.content:
ENG-ROOF-7JS：A roof engineering survey of the main arena roof sections at Acadiana Regional Exposition Center recorded a mean roof drainage slope gradient of 1.5% toward the primary scuppers.
ENG-ROOF-MV7：A roof engineering survey across the main arena roof sections at Bayou Pines Sports Complex determined a mean roof drainage slope gradient of 2.0% toward the primary scuppers.
ENG-ROOF-6VK：A roof engineering survey of the main arena roof sections at Pelican State Event Center documented a mean roof drainage slope gradient of 2.5% toward primary scuppers.

information_points.title: Maintains structural integrity, building envelope wind tolerance, and physical fortification evaluations（STRUC）
information_points.content:
ENG-STRUC-1AI：The main facility structural frame and building envelope of Acadiana Regional Exposition Center has a certified design structural wind resistance rating of 160 mph, measured as a three-second gust design wind speed under ASCE 7 hazard standards.
ENG-STRUC-RPA：The main facility structural frame and building envelope of Pelican State Event Center has a certified design structural wind resistance rating of 150 mph, determined by a three-second gust design wind speed under ASCE 7 hazard standards.
ENG-STRUC-I7B：The main facility structural frame and building envelope of Bayou Pines Sports Complex has a certified design structural wind resistance rating of 140 mph, based on a three-second gust design wind speed evaluated under ASCE 7 hazard standards.
